_comment: How this repository is divided. Every step reads it, no gate judges by it, and a round that changes the structure updates it. Fill `modules` in and delete both `_comment` and `_example`. A single-module project declares one module whose `path` is `.`. `targets` names Makefile TARGETS, not commands, and `null` means this module has no target of that kind — which is also how a module with no tests says so.

web.role: the browser client - what a user sees

service.role: the HTTP API every client talks to
